# 律与历史的完备对应 / The complete correspondence of law and history

## 主张 Claim

设 S 为配置类型，A 为动作类型，历史是一对序列 g : ℕ → S 与 m : ℕ → A。律 P 容许历史（Admits P g m），指历史的每一步都是 P 的一步；运行的历史为其律所容许（Run.admits）。一族历史 H 所显示的律（ShownBy H）以 H 中历史所走的各步为步；它是容许 H 中每段历史的最小的律（ShownBy.admits、shownBy_le_iff）。一族历史含有它的拼接（SpliceClosed H），指每个由它自己的步组成的序列都在族中。律的历史族含有它的拼接（admits_spliceClosed）；一族历史恰在含有它的拼接时是某个律的历史族，它所显示的律就是这样一个律（family_iff）。一族历史一致（ConsistentFamily H），指其中任何两段历史从不以同一动作把同一配置带到两处；它所显示的律恰在这时确定（shownBy_determined_iff），一族历史恰在含有它的拼接且一致时是某个确定的律的历史族（determined_family_iff）。律的活的步（live P）是它的某段历史所走的步；律与它的活的步容许同样的历史（admits_live_iff），两个律恰在活的步相同时容许同样的历史（same_histories_iff），活的律没有死路（live_live），死路的那一步不是活的（DeadEnd.not_live）。所以不计死路的律与含有拼接的历史族一一对应：拼接与死路就是律与历史之间的全部规律。会停止的历史下没有死路：两个律恰在步相同时有同样的有限历史（same_finite_histories_iff）；一族有限历史恰在由它的步组成时，即空序列不移动、序列是第一步接其余时，是某个律的有限历史族（MadeOfSteps、finite_family_iff）。死路是不终止历史的事实。不加前提。 / Let S be a type of configurations and A one of moves; a history is a pair of sequences g : ℕ → S and m : ℕ → A. A law P admits a history (Admits P g m) where every step the history takes is a step of P; a run's history is admitted by its law (Run.admits). The law a family of histories H shows (ShownBy H) has as steps the steps its histories take; it is the least law admitting each history of H (ShownBy.admits, shownBy_le_iff). A family holds its splices (SpliceClosed H) where every sequence made of its own steps is in it. The histories of a law hold their splices (admits_spliceClosed), and a family is the family of some law's histories exactly where it holds its splices, the law it shows being one such law (family_iff). A family is consistent (ConsistentFamily H) where no two of its histories take one move at one configuration to two outcomes; the law it shows is determined exactly then (shownBy_determined_iff), and a family is the family of a determined law's histories exactly where it holds its splices and is consistent (determined_family_iff). The live steps of a law (live P) are those some history of it takes; a law and its live steps admit the same histories (admits_live_iff), two laws admit the same histories exactly where they have the same live steps (same_histories_iff), the live law has no dead end (live_live), and the dead end's step is not live (DeadEnd.not_live). So laws up to their dead ends and families holding their splices correspond one to one: splicing and dead ends are the whole law of law and history. With histories that stop no dead end remains: two laws have the same finite histories exactly where they have the same steps (same_finite_histories_iff), and a family of finite histories is a law's exactly where it is made of its steps, the empty course going nowhere and a course being a first step followed by the rest (MadeOfSteps, finite_family_iff). The dead end is a fact of unending histories. No premise.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 不加前提：family_iff、determined_family_iff、shownBy_determined_iff、same_histories_iff 与 admits_live_iff 是双向的，对每个律与每族历史成立。 / No premise: family_iff, determined_family_iff, shownBy_determined_iff, same_histories_iff and admits_live_iff are two-way and hold for every law and every family of histories.
- 历史有两种：不终止的序列（核心的运行）与有限的动作序列（Trace）；死路只在前者中出现。 / Histories are of two kinds: unending sequences (the core's runs) and finite courses (Trace); dead ends occur only in the first.
- 一族历史是序列对上的谓词；族之间的相等以“对每段历史等价”陈述，不用函数外延性。 / A family is a predicate on pairs of sequences; families are compared by equivalence at every history, without function extensionality.

P76（工作板），按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“move towards 100%”：完备在强的意义上，即一类规律是该类的全部规律，此前只对计数成立（tally_iff_counted）。P69 证明历史固定它所显示的律，并指出对应不是同一之处：死路与拼接；这里证明这两者就是全部。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：Ren 同意律与历史是同一展开的两种读法、律从展开读出（“there are no two realities”）；在本结果之下，从历史读出的律就是含有拼接的历史族，别无其他；置于展开之上的律所能多出的只是死路，没有历史显示它们；拼接是记忆的缺席：律从所在处作答，不从怎样来到此处作答。见整合文档 §98。 / P76 (work board), following Ren's “move towards 100%” of 12 October 2026: completeness in the strong sense, the laws of a kind being all its laws, held before for counting only (tally_iff_counted). P69 proved that a history fixes the law it shows and named where the correspondence is not an identity, dead ends and splices; this shows that these two are the whole of it. Reading (the AI's, pending Ren): Ren agreed that law and history are one unfolding read two ways, the law read off the unfolding (“there are no two realities”); with this result, a law read off histories is a family of histories holding its splices and nothing else; what a law set over the unfolding can add are dead ends, which no history shows; the splice is memory's absence: a law answers from where one is, not from how one came there. See the integration document §98.

- 死路：有一步而没有历史的律（DeadEnd.no_history），它的步不是活的（DeadEnd.not_live）；拼接：重访的历史所显示的律容许它没走过的历史（Splice.spliced）。 / Dead end: a law with a step and no history (DeadEnd.no_history), whose step is not live (DeadEnd.not_live); splice: the law a revisiting history shows admits a history it never took (Splice.spliced).
